intent: Same AVITA identity, independent desktop composition. One continuous scrolling page.
contentWidth: 1320px maximum; 48px desktop margins, 32px tablet margins, 20px mobile margins (16px at 370px and below)
typography: Modern sans serif; responsive 41–80px headlines, 15–17px body text, and 10–13px labels and navigation

compositions.home: Off-white split with aligned headline and framed prism image; balanced vertical padding, image caption, and fine taxonomy strip below
compositions.about: Near-black asymmetric editorial layout; statement left, studio and introduction right; compact founders and horizontal process below
compositions.services: Off-white editorial split; heading and landscape visual left, six numbered service rows right
compositions.work: Dark curated portfolio; landscape feature with side metadata, three supporting landscape projects below
compositions.contact: Off-white contact details and rounded form card with outlined inputs; landscape geometry and short brand statement below
compositions.footer: Dark minimal brand, positioning, copyright and founder initials; no section navigation

responsive: Navigation collapses at 960px. Below 760px, sections and portfolio stack; hero and services retain landscape artwork, and project information sits below images.
motion: Small reveals, subtle image hover scale, native smooth scrolling; reduced motion respected
publication: Local only. No hosting, deployment, GitHub push or repository creation.
imagery: Reuse the exact approved landscape studio, project and contact images; expand the existing portrait hero and services scenes horizontally using direct image references, preserving their objects and visual design.
